upstream_behavior.FeetechMotorsBus_DEGREES: Degree-mode body-joint values are converted to raw motor units without calibration-range clamping.
upstream_behavior.FeetechMotorsBus_RANGE_0_100: The upstream gripper normalization bounds values to 0..100 before raw-unit conversion.
upstream_behavior.SO101Follower.send_action: With max_relative_target=None, no relative goal clipping is applied.
upstream_behavior.sent_action_semantics: The returned sent_action is the normalized command returned by the official robot API, before internal raw-register conversion.

frozen_policy.task_prompt: Task 1 PickLift v1: grasp the 2 cm red cube and lift it >=5 cm with bilateral finger hold

policy_timing.semantics: For the 30-second wall-time window, each tick executes once, then sleeps max(period - tick_compute_time, 0). A slow tick does not advance an absolute deadline and does not trigger queued catch-up actions; actual tick count is recorded rather than backfilled.

ready_pose_movement.post_interpolation_behavior: hold exact frozen ready target until arrival tolerance is observed
ready_pose_movement.start: observed joint state at movement start
ready_pose_movement.target: the same frozen ready_pose.state for every trial

scope: Task1 fixed-100k ACT pilot continuation with three-second ready/return outside the scored window
